def signal_analysis_matches(a):
    actual,target=a['measured']['events'],a['expected'];n=a['measured']['samples']
    if not a['measured']['legal'] or len(actual)!=len(target):return False
    for x,y in zip(actual,target):
        if abs(x['frequency']-y['frequency'])/y['frequency']>.05:return False
        if any(abs(x[k]-y[k])>30 for k in ['onset_ms','offset_ms']):return False
        if abs((x['offset_ms']-x['onset_ms'])-(y['offset_ms']-y['onset_ms']))>30:return False
    for x1,x2,y1,y2 in zip(actual,actual[1:],target,target[1:]):
        if abs((x2['onset_ms']-x1['offset_ms'])-(y2['onset_ms']-y1['offset_ms']))>30:return False
    return abs(n/8-target[-1]['offset_ms'])<=30

    route=row['gold_route']

    totals['families']+=1;totals['route_correct']+=route_hit;totals['gold_route_end_to_end_correct']+=gold_hit;totals['real_route_end_to_end_correct']+=real_hit
